block.createmetallurgy.light_bulb.toolti: Emits _light_ proportionally to the _Redstone_ signal received, can be in _network_ with others bulbs.
block.createmetallurgy.mechanical_grinde: Use _Rotational Force_ to sand down anything above it, even _You_ and your _Armor_!
block.createmetallurgy.faucet.tooltip.su: Use to vertically transport fluids up to _5 blocks_ down!
item.createmetallurgy.ladle.tooltip.summ: A new way to _carry molten fluids_ around! Can be used as a _bigger bucket_. Disclaimer: Can burn if not safely handled!
item.createmetallurgy.gauge_attachment.t: A gauge that can be _placed_ on different machines to _give additional information_!
_WIP_ feature. Keep loosing track of your logistics? Beloved by engineers, it is used to _label_ incoming ladles.
_Write down_ all the _addresses_ in the clipboard starting with _'#'_ on the ladle. If _left blank, erase_ them all.
_Overwrite_ the current address with the _next one_.
